parameters.name: KeyWord
parameters.description: The keyword for the group name. The search uses the %KeyWord% pattern and is case-insensitive.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese

- en: English

Default value: zh

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The start value is **1**. The default value is **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is **100**. The default value is **20**.
